title: Brief
description: Body of an `objective` artifact: what one Worker run is given (PROP-0010). It carries pointers to artifacts by content id, never their content; the Worker source resolves them when it renders the brief into its own prompt format (design/workflow-engine.md#briefs). 1.1 adds `instructions`; 1.2 adds `ask` and `files`; 1.3 adds an acceptance criterion's `check`; 1.4 adds `tier`; 1.5 adds `model`; 1.6 adds `handbook`.

tier.description: 1.4: the tier routing served the run at, when its Worker offers several (ADR-0073): its source runs that tier's model. From the route decision, never from model text.

model.description: 1.5, with `tier`: the model the Worker's source configuration runs at that tier (ADR-0073), from the source (`WorkerSource.model`), never from model text. Configuration, shown only.

check.description: 1.3: what checks the criterion, as its board task names it (board-task acceptance `check`), so a Worker that measures the change knows which criteria are its to run.

artifacts.description: Pointers to what the Worker should read, by content id.

role.description: input: the material to work on; context: background; prior: an earlier attempt's result or digest; review: findings to address.

instructions.description: 1.1: what the Worker is told, in order, as its template words it: text, and pointers placed by their index in `artifacts`, whose text the Worker source puts there when it renders the brief. The text is the template's, the caller's, and what the engine composed; never the content of an artifact the brief points to.

subject.description: The exact subject the run starts from, e.g. the worktree's commit.

ask.description: 1.2: the Worker may answer with questions instead of a result, when it cannot finish without a person's answer: its whole answer is then one JSON object {"questions": [...]}, 1 to `maxQuestions` of them, each 1 to 500 characters. The engine asks the lead or the operator (a board task's question wait) and briefs the next attempt with the answers (design/workflow-engine.md#a-question-from-a-run).

files.description: 1.2: files the Worker source writes into the run's workspace before the run starts, read-only for the agent and never read back, each the text of the artifact it points at, under `.system/`, which git ignores there; a source with no workspace of the run's own writes none. The board task's `TASKS.md` projection, for one (design/workflow-engine.md#tasksmd-in-a-runs-workspace). Every ref is also an input of the brief's envelope (INV-12).

budget.description: What the run may still draw: per pool, and a deadline.

sandbox.description: The confinement the run is held to, from trusted configuration, never from model text.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the run's workspace (a git worktree per writing task).

network.description: none, or only the hosts the egress policy allows.

commands.description: Whether the Worker may run commands, inside the confinement.

resume.description: The agent's own session to resume, when the runtime keeps one.

fork.description: Fork the session instead of continuing it (a reviewer reads a copy).

handbook.description: 1.6: the handbook slice the Worker was given (design/handbook.md#what-a-brief-records): the 6,000-token bound and its mode, what selected the slice, and per layer its version, who rendered it (the engine its half, as a `handbook-slice@1.0` context pointer; the Worker source the gate view and the lessons), the ids of the parts it carried, and its size in estimated tokens (ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4); the source's lessons at what they render to, a source part whose size cannot be read before routing at its constructed maximum).

tokens.description: The slice's estimated tokens in all, both halves.

class.description: The step's kind of work (ADR-0057), when it names one.

tier.description: The risk tier the slice was selected by; off when no path map applies.

tierFrom.description: The workflow.risk-tier decision the tier is from, or map (the step's own reading of the path map), unknown (unread: heavy), or off.

paths.description: Where the touched paths were read from; unknown selects every path-keyed part.

touched.description: The touched paths, when they were read and at most 200: the Worker source selects the lessons it renders by them too.

sha256.description: The engine's half: the sha256 of the text of the layer it counted.

atMost.description: The source's half: `tokens` is its constructed maximum, for a part whose size cannot be read before the Worker is routed (the gate view; the lessons when their repository cannot be read); the Worker source records what it rendered, each part's version and size, on the workflow run (agent-workers.handbook).

classification.description: At least the strictest classification of the artifacts it points at (INV-12).

then.description: @1.3 fields (a criterion's check) are refused before @1.3.
@1.5 fields (model) are refused before @1.5, and a model is named only beside the tier it runs at.
